Ostrander Analytics Group Inc | W52P1J-22-C-0011 | Army Logistics Data Analytics Support
Monthly Status Report, October 2026
Contract
Contract W52P1J-22-C-0011, Army Logistics Data Analytics Support. Reporting period: October 1 to October 31, 2026
(option year 4). Submitted by Ostrander Analytics Group Inc to the Contracting Officer's Representative.
1. Work performed
Platform operations (line item 0001): the analytics platform ran at 99.7 percent availability; two patch releases were
deployed on October 8 and October 22.
Data engineering support (line item 0002): the supply-chain data pipeline was extended to two new depot feeds, and
the weekly readiness extract was rebuilt for the new schema.
Cybersecurity and RMF support (line item 0003): quarterly vulnerability scans completed with no high findings.
Program management (line item 0004): monthly program review held October 14.
2. Hours
Line item 0002 (labor-hour): 742 hours in October.
3. Deliverables
September monthly status report delivered October 9 and accepted.
Transition-out plan: in preparation; it will be delivered with the November report.
4. Risks and issues
No new risks this month. The depot feed integration is on schedule.
5. Staffing
One data engineer left the program on October 17. A replacement with the same labor category starts November 3.
No change to key personnel.
6. Next month
Continue platform operations and data engineering support, complete the November patch release, and begin
transition-out activities with the follow-on contractor.

Keystone Ridge Analytics LLC | W52P1J-27-C-0023 | Army Logistics Data Analytics Platform
Monthly Status Report, October 2026
Contract
Contract W52P1J-27-C-0023, Army Logistics Data Analytics Platform. Reporting period: October 23 (contract start) to
October 31, 2026, base year. Submitted by Keystone Ridge Analytics LLC to the Contracting Officer's Representative.
1. Work performed
Transition-in (line item 0005): kickoff held October 23; the transition-in plan was delivered October 26; access requests
submitted for all 14 staff; the inventory of the incumbent's open work orders is 40 percent complete.
Platform build (line item 0001): environment design started.
Data integration and engineering (line item 0002): source-system survey started.
Cybersecurity and RMF support (line item 0003): the system security plan outline was drafted.
Program management (line item 0004): integrated master schedule baselined.
2. Hours by labor category
Line item 0002 (labor-hour), October: Senior data engineer 64 hours; data engineer 120 hours; data analyst 48 hours;
total 232 hours. Cumulative for the base year: 232 hours.
Line item 0003 (labor-hour), October: Cybersecurity lead 40 hours; RMF analyst 56 hours; total 96 hours. Cumulative
for the base year: 96 hours.
3. Deliverables
Transition-in plan: delivered October 26, awaiting acceptance. Integrated master schedule: delivered October 30.
4. Risks and issues
Risk: the incumbent's transition-out plan has not been received, which could delay the hand-off of open work orders.
Mitigation: we have asked the COR to request it from the incumbent, and are building the inventory from the
work-order system directly in the meantime.
5. Staffing
All key personnel are on board: program manager, lead data architect and cybersecurity lead. 11 of 14 planned staff
started; the remaining three start November 4.
6. Next month
Complete the open work-order inventory, finish access provisioning, hold the first joint session with the incumbent, and
complete transition-in by December 22.
